::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 65,288 people lived in County Monaghan, up 6.4% on 2016. It had the 23rd largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 33% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Monaghan was €1,028, the third lowest of the 26 counties.
:::

## More about County Monaghan

- In 2024, disposable income per person in County Monaghan was €26,908, the 17th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-income-map.html)
- In 2025, the average price paid for a home in County Monaghan was €257,400, the 21st highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-prices-map.html)
- In 2025, 4.8 new homes were completed for every 1,000 people in County Monaghan, the 15th highest rate of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-completions-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 24% of households in County Monaghan rented their home, the 15th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-renting-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 23% of people living in County Monaghan were born outside Ireland, the second highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/migration-born-abroad-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 39% of people aged 3 and over in County Monaghan said they could speak Irish, the 16th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/irish-language-speakers-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 23% of people at work in County Monaghan worked from home for at least part of the week, the lowest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-work-from-home-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 75% of people travelling to work in County Monaghan went by car, the 19th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-car-to-work-map.html)
- Half of people in County Monaghan live more than 4.9 km by road from a GP, the second furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-gp-map.html)
- Half of people in County Monaghan live more than 44.2 km by road from a hospital emergency department, the furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-emergency-department-map.html)
- Forests and woodland covered 5.2% of County Monaghan in 2021, the 23rd highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/environment-forest-map.html)
